The '''Nymalia system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Eidoloni sector/Legends|Eidoloni sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was home to the [[Species/Legends|species]] known as [[Nymalian water-ox]].<ref name="Shatterpoint" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Nymalia system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square M-17.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
